item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Sunday
item.summary: President Trump taunted Iran on social media, while strikes continued in Iran, Israel, Lebanon and some Gulf states.

item.title: Trump’s Lesson From Risky Rescue: Threaten to Go Harder at Iran
item.summary: In an expletive-laced social media post, the president said Iran should open the Strait of Hormuz or he would bomb bridges and power plants.

item.title: Here’s a Timeline of Trump’s Ultimatums Over the Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: President Trump first gave Iran 48 hours to reopen the vital oil shipping route on March 21. The deadline has been reset many times since.

item.title: Trump Revels in Threats to Commit War Crimes in Iran
item.summary: The president said he would bomb Iran “back to the Stone Ages.” Until this administration, American leaders had insisted they were trying to follow international law in war.

item.title: Trump Seems Emboldened With New Threats in Truth Social Post Over Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: In an expletive-filled social media post, Mr. Trump said Iran should open the Strait of Hormuz or he will bomb bridges and power plants.

item.title: Interceptor Missiles Save Lives, but Stockpiles Are Dwindling
item.summary: Defense systems that shoot projectiles out of the sky have become one of the most important components of warfare, so much so that militaries face a diminishing supply.

item.title: Here’s What Happened in the War in the Middle East on Saturday
item.summary: The U.S. military’s search-and-rescue operation for a missing American airman entered its second day. The Israeli military struck a major petrochemical complex in Iran.

item.title: Israel Strikes Iran’s Largest Petrochemical Complex
item.summary: The sprawling complex in the city of Mahshahr was taken offline after strikes hit two utility plants that provided basic services like gas and power, Iranian officials said.

item.title: U.S. Fighter Jet Downed Over Iran Was Probably Based at R.A.F. Lakenheath, U.K. Airfield
item.summary: A military analyst identified markings consistent with a squadron based at R.A.F. Lakenheath, one of two British bases that host the largest U.S. fighter jet operation in Europe.

item.title: A projectile hit near Iran’s Bushehr nuclear plant, killing a worker.
item.summary: There was no reported increase in radiation levels. A string of recent attacks near the Persian Gulf facility has fueled fears of a nuclear accident.
